6 years proven experience with Java or Kotlin, including mastery in concurrency, memory management, and performance optimization techniques.
8 years proven mastery in OOP principles, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns (e.g. GoF), with a proven focus on implementing testable, maintainable, and extensible backend code.
6 years proven experience in least one modern frontend stack (such as React/Next.js) coupled with LLM feature development, utilizing the top 3 ecosystem languages: TypeScript, Python, and JavaScript.
B.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional work experience.
Preferred qualifications: Track record of leading software projects that span multiple, distributed teams as a tech lead (TL), while mentoring senior-level software engineers.
Hands-on experience leveraging GenAI coding tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot, Codex) to accelerate the software development lifecycle, enhance code quality, and streamline debugging and testing processes.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Apple Ads
description:
Apple is where we use the power of technology to enrich people's lives. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. Join the Apple Ads Engineering team and help build an advertising platform that benefits both customers and advertisers. Our technology makes advertising possible on the App Store, Apple News, Stocks, and Apple TV — helping people discover content, supporting creators and publishers, and connecting advertisers of all sizes with engaged audiences, all with the unwavering commitment to privacy you expect from Apple. Strong background in computer science fundamentals, including algorithms and data structures.
Strong coding skills in Go, Java, Rust, C++, Scala, or a similar OOP/Functional language.

A desire to work in a fast-paced and challenging environment, and a fast learner with strong motivation for growing and learning new technologies.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Apple Services Engineering
description:
The Apple Services Engineering (ASE) team builds the container and virtualization runtime technology that powers Apple's next-generation compute platform. We're a fast-moving, highly skilled team of systems engineers designing and developing the virtualization-based runtimes that run Virtual Machines and Linux Containers across our data center, with privacy, security, and performance as first-class requirements.
We're starting a new team focused on one question: how do we patch the node software across our datacenter fleet faster, and more often, with minimal impact to the workloads running on it? We're looking for a domain expert to decide the approach and then build and lead the team that delivers it.
Today, updating a node's software means choosing between speed and workload impact. This team's job is to remove that tradeoff, so we can patch the fleet faster and more often with minimal impact on users. We have not chosen an approach. Live migration, snapshot and restore, kexec-based host updates, live patching, and in-place upgrade of the runtime and VMM are all options, and a different approach may fit better than any of them. We are looking for an expert to decide and guide: which approach, or combination, gets us there, what it costs in workload impact and operational risk, and how we measure the result.
You will:
* Define the fleet patching strategy: evaluate the candidate approaches (including ones we haven't listed), choose, and make the tradeoffs explicit, grounded in a model of how each one fails.
* Set the metrics that matter, such as guest-visible downtime, total migration time, network amplification, abortability, and time to patch the fleet.
* Design and drive the first implementation, building on Cloud Hypervisor and our Linux microVM runtimes on x86 and arm64.
* Hire and grow the team. Depending on your background and interests this is a technical-lead role or a people-management role, and we will decide that together.
* Work with the SRE, Compute, and security organizations on rollout, safety, and fleet operations.
Minimum qualifications: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or equivalent related experience.
At least 8+ years of software design and development experience in infrastructure engineering (compute, storage and network virtualization).
Deep, demonstrated experience in one of the following, and working fluency in the other: Operating live migration, live patching, or kexec-style host updates across a production fleet, including the failures: non-convergence, aborts and rollback, and fleet-wide rollout safety. Building live migration, snapshot/restore, or device-state serialization inside a hypervisor or VMM (for example QEMU/KVM, Cloud Hypervisor, Firecracker, Xen, or Hyper-V).
Advanced programming language proficiency in C, C++, Rust, Swift or Go, with a track record of designing and developing high performance, secured, scalable and reliable systems.
Track record of owning technical design end-to-end, from design docs and architecture tradeoffs through implementation and review.
Experience setting technical direction for a group of engineers, with or without formal management responsibility.
Preferred qualifications: Experience with Linux kernel and system programming (KVM, userfaultfd, VFIO, kexec, kernel live patching).
Understanding of dirty-page tracking, memory and device state handling, and time and CPU-model compatibility across hosts.
Experience with live migration of devices that carry hardware state (VFIO, vDPA, SR-IOV).
Experience designing benchmarks and load tests to characterize downtime and performance impact during an upgrade.
Experience contributing to or maintaining open source virtualization projects (Cloud Hypervisor, rust-vmm, QEMU, KVM).
Experience with Kubernetes node lifecycle, draining, and fleet rollout orchestration.
Experience building a new team from zero, including hiring.

title: Senior Software Engineer, G&A Solutions Engineering (GSE)
description:
G&A Solutions Engineering (GSE) is IS&T's dedicated technology partner for Apple's general and administrative functions — including people, finance, facilities, legal, and security. The team builds and delivers integrated technology solutions that keep these functions running efficiently and securely at global scale. GSE also works closely with business teams to develop custom tools that improve productivity and bring greater automation and consistency to G&A operations across Apple.
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization.
IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.
Minimum qualifications: 5 years proven experience developing software in a professional capacity.
4 years proven experience with Java or Kotlin, including proficiency in concurrency, memory management, and performance optimization techniques.
Proficiency in OOP principles, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns (e.g. GoF), with a proven focus on implementing testable, maintainable, and extensible backend code.
4 years proven experience in least one modern frontend stack (such as React/Next.js) coupled with LLM feature development, utilizing the top 3 ecosystem languages: TypeScript, Python, and JavaScript.
B.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional work experience.
Preferred qualifications: Track record of leading software projects within a team as a tech lead (TL), while mentoring software engineers.
Hands-on experience leveraging GenAI coding tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot, Codex) to accelerate the software development lifecycle, enhance code quality, and streamline debugging and testing processes.

title: SoC Embedded Software Engineer for Factory
description:
Do you love crafting elegant solutions to highly sophisticated challenges? As part of our Silicon Technologies group, you’ll help design and manufacture our next-generation, high-performance, power-efficient processor, system-on-chip (SoC). You’ll ensure Apple products and services can seamlessly and efficiently handle the tasks that make them beloved by millions. Joining this group means you’ll be responsible for crafting and building the technology that fuels Apple’s devices. Together, we will enable our customers to do all the things they love with their devices!
At Apple, we go beyond the industry norm and demonstrate creativity in problem solving, ability to think dynamically and outside of standard convention, and adapt quickly to new technical areas. We promote innovation and new technology. The people who work here have reinvented and defined entire industries with the Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Vision, Apple TV, AirPods, HomePod and a multitude of groundbreaking Accessories. We have done the same with services, including iTunes, the App Store, Apple Music, and Apple Pay. The same passion for innovation that goes into our products also applies to our practices — strengthening our dedication to leave the world better than we found it. You should join us to help deliver the next amazing Apple product!
Joining Apple as an Embedded Software Engineer for SoC Factory Support, you will craft and implement embedded software for System on a Chip (SoC) bring up and test. You will write software for Apple silicon in a production boot loader environment. You will work closely with the Product Engineering teams to bring up new silicon on device and ensure the SoC quality when manufactured.
- Design and implementation of firmware for SoC bring up, validation, and test.
- Identify, analyze and root-cause SoC failures in the factory.
- Enhance and maintain the development and debug environments, tools and methodologies.
- Support of functional test environment for device characterization, failure analysis, and mass production.
- Generate post-silicon directed diagnostic and stress test cases and debugging failure cases using multiple HW and low level SW platforms.
- Use of soft skills and data driven approach to effectively collaborate and participate in multi-team discussions and decision-making.
Minimum qualifications: Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or related field.
Preferred qualifications: Embedded software experience, including debugging and characterization
Experience with embedded C programming
Experience on SoC silicon bring up/power up
Experience with problem solving and delivery of high volume and high quality SW
Experience debugging boot loader is a plus
Experience using laboratory equipment (e.g., logic analyzer, digital oscilloscope) is a plus
Strong communication skills

title: Software Development Engineer - iOS for Keyboard
description:
Join the Keyboard Infrastructure team to build and maintain the foundational systems that power keyboard behavior across iOS & iPadOS. You'll own keyboard focus, lifecycle management, and the APIs that apps use to interact with keyboard layout — directly impacting every text input experience on iPhone and iPad.
Design, develop, and maintain the keyboard focus system, ensuring correct and predictable focus behavior across complex app hierarchies
Own keyboard lifecycle management — presentation, dismissal, transitions, and state restoration
Build and maintain APIs for keyboard layout that apps rely on for positioning, insets, and animation coordination
Ensure keyboard infrastructure works reliably across multitasking, Stage Manager, and diverse app architectures
Collaborate with UIKit, SwiftUI, and framework teams to provide consistent keyboard behavior
Debug and resolve complex issues spanning focus engines, responder chain, and windowing
Write clear documentation and provide guidance to internal and external developers adopting keyboard layout APIs
Minimum qualifications: BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience
2+ years of experience in iOS/macOS development (Swift, Objective-C)
Strong foundation in systems programming, state management, and framework design
Experience designing or maintaining public APIs
Preferred qualifications: Deep knowledge of UIKit internals — responder chain, UIWindow, UIScene, and view layout systems
Familiarity with keyboard avoidance, input accessory views, and text input architecture (UITextInput, UIKeyInput)
Experience shipping frameworks or infrastructure used by other engineering teams
Understanding of accessibility requirements for keyboard and focus interactions
Track record of diagnosing and fixing subtle lifecycle and state-management bugs

title: Software Development Engineer in Test - Camera API
description:
Join the team responsible for ensuring the highest quality for Camera technologies at the heart of products known to surprise and delight our customers. The Camera API Quality Engineering team is part of the Camera and Photos organization and is responsible for validating functionality & stability of Camera Software, firmware and hardware integrations across Apple products.
This is a highly technical team, always looking for innovative ways to improve the status quo and solve difficult problems. We are looking for someone who can lead the charge on quality for one or more technology areas. You will work in a fast paced environment, interacting directly with development teams within the organization as well as cross-functional teams. The nature of the position requires excellent communication skills, strong multitasking abilities & deep technical and debugging skills, along with a drive to make a difference. The ideal candidate will be highly technical, creative, motivated, and results driven.
At Apple, we believe the camera is more than a feature — it’s a creative tool that empowers millions of people to capture, communicate, and tell their stories. The Camera API Test Team plays a critical role in ensuring that developers around the world can rely on powerful, intuitive, and rock-solid camera frameworks across Apple platforms.
We are looking for a passionate and detail-oriented Camera API Test Engineer to help validate and elevate the quality of Apple’s camera software stack. In this role, you will work at the intersection of hardware, software, and developer experience, helping shape APIs that power world-class photography and videography on iPhone, iPad, and beyond.
Minimum qualifications: Solid API test development skills
Familiarity with Python, C/ObjectiveC programming
Bachelor's in Computer Science/Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience/skills
Preferred qualifications: Experience with developing, testing or debugging device drivers, firmware or other low level software
Experience in photography; ability to understand various camera technology terms like aperture control, exposure values, JPEG format, Raw format etc.
Experience in developing and maintaining CI systems
Highly motivated, creative, and organized
Strong problem solving skills and excellent cross-functional communication

title: Software Engineer (Platform Software Engineer), G&A Solutions Engineering (GSE)
description:
G&A Solutions Engineering (GSE) is IS&T's dedicated technology partner for Apple's general and administrative functions — including people, finance, facilities, legal, and security. The team builds and delivers integrated technology solutions that keep these functions running efficiently and securely at global scale. GSE also works closely with business teams to develop custom tools that improve productivity and bring greater automation and consistency to G&A operations across Apple.
When you engineer for People Systems, your users are Apple’s most vital asset: its People. We are seeking a Senior Platform Engineer to shape the technical strategy for People Systems with a passion for platforms where configuration is the product, and agentic workflows that redefine what's possible.
You will be working on a Platform that helps define features. Data models, rules, workflows, permissions, screens and reports are all versioned configuration, interpreted at runtime, so the people closest to a problem can change how the system behaves without waiting for a release. Hundreds of components must behave as one system. We are looking for a passionate engineer who can make that true.
We value engineers who bring both technical excellence and product thinking. You'll make the architectural calls that balance fast delivery against long-term platform health, and build systems that are scalable, secure and resilient by design rather than by retrofit. This role requires someone who thrives on complexity but ships simplicity.
Collaboration is central to how we work. You’ll partner with product managers and cross-functional engineering teams to understand problems deeply before reaching for solutions. The best engineers here are the ones who ask “why” before “how". If you care deeply about precision, data integrity, and crafting platforms where scale meets human empathy, come join us to do the best work of your life.
Minimum qualifications: 4 years of professional backend or platform engineering, building scalable distributed systems
4 years experience in building or contributing to components of a configuration-driven or metadata-driven platform used by multiple teams: metadata models, multi-tenancy, extensibility and versioned APIs
4 years of professional development in TypeScript or Java (21+) and Spring Boot (or equivalent), microservices patterns and async programming: virtual threads, coroutines or reactive programming
4 years of working knowledge of distributed systems: consistency, fault tolerance, partitioning and failure-mode analysis
BS/MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Preferred qualifications: Comfortable across technology stacks rather than tied to one: picks up whatever language, framework or datastore a component demands
Experience with event-driven systems on Kafka (or equivalent): ordering, idempotent consumers, replay and schema evolution
Working expertise with relational or NoSQL databases: schema design, query optimization, migrations and transaction management
Designed or contributed to APIs and contracts consumed by other teams: versioning, backward compatibility and documentation
Experience with multi-tenant or security-sensitive systems: authorization, data isolation and audit
Operated production systems: monitoring, alerting, health checks, incident response and a post-mortem culture, with working knowledge of rollout practice (canary, feature flags, rollback)
Demonstrated experience with AI-native development in an orchestrated workflow: specifying tasks for coding agents, coordinating them across steps, and verifying their output with tests and review
Test engineering and delivery automation fundamentals: test design and the test pyramid, deterministic and contract tests, flaky-test management, and CI/CD pipelines
Ability to break down ambiguous problems with guidance and to communicate trade-offs clearly to engineers and product partners
Experience running configuration-driven systems where non-engineers change behaviour, including validation, impact preview, promotion and rollback
Background in CQRS, event sourcing, or saga-based orchestration patterns for long-running workflows
Experience building platform-based solutions in the People space
Familiarity with compliance and audit requirements in systems handling sensitive personal data (PII, financial, or regulated HR data)
Experience decomposing or extending monolithic systems into services that interoperate with an existing system of record
Fluency with developer experience for platform consumers: SDKs, local test harnesses and self-service onboarding
Experience building agents that act on engineering workflows (test generation, code review, failure triage), with sandboxed execution and human approval for any change
Experience building self-healing automation that detects and remediates known failure patterns, with safe limits and human approval for risky actions

title: Software Engineer - 3D Vision & Perception
description:
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build or service we create is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something!
We are a team of computer vision and machine learning (CVML) engineers building real-time 3D perception and input systems for future Apple products. We are looking for a senior software engineer with strong C++ expertise and experience developing performance-critical systems, ideally in 3D perception, robotics, or AR/VR. In this role, you will help design, build, and ship core 3D perception and input technologies used by millions of users.
You will work closely with CVML researchers and engineers to develop world-class perception, spatial input, and 3D tracking software. The role focuses on building, integrating, and maintaining complex real-time systems within a large production software stack. As a member of a fast-paced team, you have the unique and rewarding opportunity to shape upcoming products that will delight and inspire millions of people every day.
Minimum qualifications: Bachelor’s degree and 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
Strong C++ skills, including modern C++
Experience breaking down large problems and delivering robust solutions
Curiosity about new technologies and flexibility to work across different layers of the software stack
Preferred qualifications: Experience with iOS or visionOS development, including Swift and Apple tooling
Proven track record of shipping products or contributing to open-source projects
Experience deploying algorithms to GPUs or other hardware accelerators
Strong engineering rigor, communication, and collaboration skills
Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities

title: Software Engineer – Digital Asset Management, Retail & Marcom Engineering
description:
At Apple, we strive every single day to craft products and platforms that enrich people’s lives. Our successes are the result of skilled domain experts working in an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and rethinking old problems in new ways.
Retail and Marcom Engineering, an IS&T team, builds and operates the systems and experiences that connect Apple's products with its customers. The team owns the technology behind both Apple's online and physical stores and drives the interactive marketing experiences and tools that keep creative operations moving. Together, those functions deliver the technology behind every product story Apple tells and every purchase a customer makes.
As a member of the Digital Asset Management (DAM) Engineering team, you will design and develop next-generation enterprise asset platforms that manage, transform, index, and distribute massive volumes of creative and digital assets worldwide. You will sit at the intersection of enterprise software engineering, machine learning, and generative AI—infusing intelligent search, semantic understanding, auto-tagging, multimodal indexing, and AI-driven automation into foundational asset workflows. You will have the unique and rewarding opportunity to shape high-scale, mission-critical systems relied upon daily by cross-functional teams across Apple.
Our team is looking for a passionate, technically skilled software engineer who thrives in designing scalable distributed backend systems and integrating cutting-edge machine learning and generative AI capabilities. You will work autonomously within a collaborative team, partnering closely with product managers, ML practitioners, platform architects, and downstream engineering teams. We rely on your technical leadership and hands-on expertise to design resilient architectures, evolve enterprise DAM platforms, and implement robust AI/ML pipelines that deliver high impact.
Minimum qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related technical field, or
equivalent practical experience.
3+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong focus on backend
systems.
Strong proficiency in Java (including modern Java features, concurrency, performance profiling,
and frameworks such as Spring Boot).
Practical experience designing and operating RESTful APIs, event-driven architectures, or
distributed streaming systems (e.g., Apache Kafka or equivalent modern message brokers).
Familiarity with database technologies (relational databases such as PostgreSQL and
search/vector stores like Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or Milvus/Pinecone).
Preferred qualifications: Digital Asset Management Experience: Hands-on experience developing, configuring, or
extending enterprise or open-source DAM platforms or similar content repository engines.
Understanding of core computer science concepts, including algorithms, data structures,
distributed systems, and concurrent programming.
Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Alibaba Cloud).
ML & Generative AI Integration: Hands-on experience applying ML or generative AI in
production software, such as integrating machine learning inference services, large language
models, embeddings, vector databases, computer vision models, or LLM-based pipelines (e.g.,
LangChain, model serving via Triton/TorchServe, prompt engineering, or multimodal search).
Distributed Storage & Media Processing: Familiarity with cloud object storage (S3), content
delivery networks (CDNs), and media processing pipelines.
DevOps & Cloud-Native Tooling: Working familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-
code, and production telemetry (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana).
Strong analytical problem-solving skills, with enthusiasm to tackle ambiguous technical
challenges in a fast-paced environment.

title: Software Quality Engineer, Retail & Marcom Engineering
description:

There are countless ways you can contribute here, from working on apple.com to software for digital & physical Apple Stores, from software for Apple Care to Apple-wide systems for identity, operations, recruiting, and people management, from software for Apple data centers to Apple-wide data processing & AI/ML systems.
When you join IS&T, you’ll help design and manage systems, frameworks, and apps that countless Apple customers and employees rely on every day. Experience with modern test automation frameworks such as Playwright/Selenium, Appium with Java, Typescript/JS or Python
Build and improve QE frameworks, tools, and infrastructure that increase engineering productivity
Design and implement scalable automation across UI, API, integration, and end-to-end testing.

title: Sr Software Engineer, Infrastructure Services
description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization.

focused on building highly scalable distributed control planes, cloud orchestration engines or
software-defined networking (SDN) controllers

stateful connection tracking.

title: Sr iOS Software Engineer, Creativity Apps
description:
At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming phenomenal products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. You bring passion, and dedication to your job and there is no telling what you could accomplish.

Track record of mentoring others while remaining open to learning and asking for help

title: Sr. Art Director, Packaging
description:
Marcom is the creatively-led global team that oversees Apple’s consumer facing marketing. We ensure the flawless development and execution of world-class communications across all medias and platforms. title: Sr. Software Engineer, Enterprise Technology Services (Forge)
description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.
At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. That same passion for innovation that goes into our products also applies to our practices, strengthening our dedication to leave the world better than we found it!
Most software engineering roles hand off testing to one team and operations to another. Here you own all of it. As a Software Engineer on Forge, you'll design, build, test, ship, and run the platform Apple's engineering teams build on, working closely with those teams to find where the infrastructure beneath them gets in the way and fixing it.
Forge is part of Enterprise Technology Services (ETS), within Apple's Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization, the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. Forge is building the platform Apple's engineering organizations can use to take a service from code to running in production. That path has traditionally run through a series of separate specialist systems. We are bringing it together on a common platform with a shared core, so a team goes from allocated capacity to a live production service without assembling the pieces themselves. Our job is to get teams to production quickly, on a platform that stays secure and reliable without them having to think about it.
Our charter is deliberately wide and still growing, reaching from the physical fleet in the data center to the surfaces engineering teams build against, and extending into new environments and new classes of infrastructure as Apple's needs evolve. We are a small team with outsized reach, bringing an AI-first mindset to how the platform operates and improves itself, and the best work we do takes one team's hardest problem and turns it into a capability every team inherits.
You will work with product owners, infrastructure owners, and partner engineers to turn ambiguous, high-impact problems into clean solutions. You'll own products that ETS teams depend on every day. You will also help define how AI agents work in production alongside humans, in the same codebases our engineers ship to daily.
The role mixes product engineering with hands-on integration work. You may start closer to one than the other, and you should be comfortable moving between them as the work changes.
We are looking for strong full-stack engineers who have owned work through production, have built something with LLMs or agents, can design securely and for scale, and want to grow into leading designs and mentoring others.
Minimum qualifications: B.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
5+ years of professional software development, with a track record of owning features or integrations through production
Full-stack experience: a backend language such as Java (Spring Boot or similar) and a modern web UI framework such as React or Angular
Experience designing features with security principles (threat modeling, authentication and authorization, least privilege, secure data handling) and scalable patterns (stateless services, caching, asynchronous messaging, retries, circuit breakers, back-pressure), and explaining your trade-offs in design reviews
Have built an LLM- or agent-based feature, whether in production, as a prototype, or as a significant project, and can describe how you designed it and evaluated its reliability
Strong fundamentals in data structures, design patterns, REST API design, and relational databases
Hands-on observability experience: instrumenting applications with metrics, logs, and traces, and building dashboards and alerts
A record of learning new technologies quickly, working through ambiguity, and communicating clearly across teams
Preferred qualifications: Shipped agentic features to production, including tool integrations, retrieval pipelines, evaluation, and guardrails
- Python, including LLM APIs or agent frameworks
- Daily use of GenAI coding tools (Claude, Copilot, Codex) to speed up development, testing, and debugging
- Schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning on PostgreSQL, Oracle, or MySQL
- Data modeling and reconciliation across multiple sources, including data-quality measurement
- Web accessibility (WCAG) and building accessible enterprise UIs
- CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud or virtualization platforms
- Secure software practices: security design reviews, dependency and vulnerability management, compliance
- Experience leading a project or mentoring other engineers, and contributing to inner-source or open-source projects

title: Strategic Media Planning Lead, Apple Services
description:
At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming great products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. The Services Central Marketing team at Apple is responsible for cultivating awareness and education of Apple's full suite of services and driving new customer acquisition through a variety of marketing channels, including paid media, organic social, partnerships, GEO, and more.
Our growing team is looking for a Strategic Media Planning Lead supporting services across B2B and B2C verticals. This role will collaborate closely with channel teams, marketing leads, creative strategists and analytics to build data-informed recommendations and campaigns. Excellent communication, interpersonal and presentation skills are essential, along with the ability to prioritize, adapt to change and multi-task within a dynamic environment.
You will be responsible for developing paid media and cross-channel strategies within Apple Services that drive full funnel and measurable impact for the business. Additionally, you will manage workflow between our internal channel teams and business stakeholders, and the implementation of each strategy. You will analyze the performance of marketing channels and provide insights to ensure key partners understand plans, optimizations and results.
On top of developing sophisticated marketing strategies, you will position yourself as the strategic thought leader for your business stakeholders and provide direction on how to reach their desired audience via marketing channels, how to allocate budgets effectively for their objectives, and you’ll also provide insight on branding and messaging within creative. Expertise in end-to-end campaign planning and management for full funnel KPIs including awareness, engagement, and performance.
Familiarity with digital advertising, social media platforms, custom partnerships, Above The Line (OOH, Audio) and their relationship with each other in multifaceted, integrated campaigns.
Demonstrated ability to leverage data and insights to develop marketing strategies that reach a defined audience through the right channels, and tie back to business objectives.
Track record of measuring impact and growth through different testing and measurement solutions with the ability to share results and future recommendations in a digestible way.
BS/BA degree required.

Understanding of how the presence of AI is evolving the digital world, and how that impacts marketing channels, particularly advertising and GEO.
Experience working with earned and owned social teams, and particularly has been involved with creator partnerships.
Excellent presentation, written and verbal communication skills.
App growth and engagement experience a plus.
B2B Marketing experience a plus.

title: Strategic Space Planner
description:
In Places, we don’t sit back and let things happen, we make things happen, and we do this in service to all Apple employees and customers. Our team is a diverse and nimble group that manages Apple’s corporate and retail workplaces and workplace services. We develop and manage Apple’s global real estate portfolio, lead all related capital construction projects, provide outstanding facilities and site services, develop and lead sustainability initiatives to reduce the environmental impact of all Apple facilities, including commute and renewable energy programs, and do everything we can to ensure the health and safety of all Apple personnel, facilities, and customers in our facilities around the world.
The Space Planning team is responsible for establishing and driving efficient real estate strategies that support Apple's corporate space needs. We're hiring a Strategic Space Planner: an individual contributor who will be dedicated to Americas (AMR) geographic markets to lead strategic planning and migration across the portfolio.
You'll drive occupancy strategy and implementation across the AMR portfolio, ensuring space supply proactively aligns with business demand. As an action-oriented workplace strategist, you'll lead end-to-end space planning initiatives and collaborate closely with business units to translate their location strategies into scalable workplace solutions.
You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, proactively seeking clarification, weighing competing priorities against business impact, and adapting plans as business requirements evolve. You bring a data analytics background to evaluate utilization metrics, analyze capacity forecasts, and translate quantitative insights into actionable recommendations that optimize the portfolio.
Minimum qualifications: 3-5 years of experience in workplace strategy, strategic space planning, or corporate occupancy planning, preferably within a technology company or corporate campus.
Experience managing multiple space planning projects from conception through implementation.
Experience applying occupancy metrics, space utilization analysis, and scenario modeling to inform stakeholder decisions.
Experience synthesizing spatial data into visual presentations and business cases for executive audiences.
Experience negotiating space allocations and resolving competing stakeholder priorities.
Working knowledge of Computer-Aided Facility Management (CAFM) and Integrated Workplace Management System (IWMS) platforms such as (Serraview, Archibus, Tririga, or FM:Systems).
Preferred qualifications: Master's degree in Real Estate (MRED), Urban Planning, Architecture, or Business Administration (MBA), with 2 years of experience.
Proficiency in Keynote and business intelligence or data visualization platforms, such as Tableau, Power BI, or advanced Excel modeling.
Familiarity with project management platforms, such as Wrike.
Understanding of architectural drawings, test-fits, building code implications, and core-and-shell conditions.
Experience leveraging AI-driven tools to accelerate scenario planning, optimize multi-floor stacking diagrams, and analyze space data.
Skilled at influencing stakeholders and communicating complex trade-offs clearly to drive alignment.

title: System Software Developer
description:
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something.
The CoreOS Power and Performance team is looking for an experienced software developer to join us. You will have the opportunity to work on the latest Apple products and build high-quality, production software that ships to billions of Apple customers!
We are looking for a motivated engineer with excellent programming, problem-solving, and communication skills, backed by a solid wireless communication background. You will enable continued innovation by identifying and collecting meaningful radio metrics to improve Apple products. To be successful in this role, you must have a solid software engineering background coupled with a strong system understanding and the ability to write production-level code.
Minimum qualifications: Proficient in C, C++, or Objective-C, with a mastery of Python. Proactive and self-motivated with demonstrated creative and critical thinking capabilities.
Excellent spoken and written communication skills.
Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with different teams.
Strong system-level understanding and excellent debugging skills.
Good understanding of wireless communication, plus one or more of Wi-Fi or cellular protocols.
B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
Preferred qualifications: Strong mathematical foundations.
Experience with development on mobile systems.
Experience working with large, cross-functional teams.

description:

Motivate others to achieve performance goals by fostering open dialog, collaboration, and recognition.

description: The Talent Assistant - Staffing Operations supports the Staffing function with day-to-day data management, reporting, and stakeholder coordination. Leveraging digital tools and People and Finance reports to ensure data-driven, accurate execution across the staffing process. Teaming & collaboration: Works positively with stakeholders and partners with the team and a diverse network, balances individual and collaborative work, manages expectations, and escalates conflict when needed.

title: Business Manager, ATM & Cash Strategy
description:
Business Manager, ATM & Cash Strategy
On the ATM and Cash Strategy Team, you will help improve the customer experience and provide critical cash access to our customers, a key customer need that influences acquisition and strengthens primary banking relationships.  The team sits at the center of Operations, Product and the Customer, with a broad scope ranging from physical location strategy to developing recommendations to improve ATM fleet availability in support of everyday customer banking needs.
The ATM & Cash Strategy Team sits within the Market Strategy organization, focused on physical location strategy to create economic and customer value across our Branch and Cafe markets and beyond. Decisions about Capital One’s physical network of Cafes, branches and ATMs demand a careful balancing act between rigorous quantitative analysis and experience-driven qualitative judgements.  Roles within the team are based on collaborative brainstorming, creative problem solving, and nuanced storytelling.  As the team’s work touches so many aspects of the Bank’s strategy, you will handle a wide array of stakeholders with their own objectives; astute relationship management is key, especially in challenging situations.
In this role you will be responsible for:
ATM Performance Strategy: Develop strategies to address significant opportunities in support of Operations driving continued improvement in ATM availability
ATM Marketing Strategy: Collaborate with key stakeholders and develop a go forward strategy on how do we unlock the previously untapped opportunity of marketing on our ATMs to help drive PBR growth and Cafe engagement, and how do we quantify the impact?
ATM Network Analysis: Collaborate with colleagues on future ATM strategy, using available data to guide decision-making. This includes developing recommendations to optimize our physical presence, understanding drivers of value and costs, building and refining models for lease renewal terms.
Cross-functional Problem Solving: Engage with various retail bank teams to develop proposals that will influence daily operations and the broader physical presence strategy of our locations
This role will provide exposure to Market and Product, Finance, Market Planning, Design, Construction, External Affairs, Real Estate Transactions, GIS, operations, etc. Special projects may cover long-term growth optimization projections, new ways of interacting with customers in-person, budget planning, creating SLT dashboards, Board and CEO deck creation, developing new KPIs and success metrics, and refining financial models.
General Responsibilities:
Strategic leadership: Develop business strategies that will drive growth, profitability, and competitive success for Capital One in the face of shifting consumer and regulatory demands. Display an intense focus on achieving both short and long term goals. Able to drive and execute an agenda in an uncertain and fluid environment
Analytics: A proven track record of decision making and problem solving based on analytics will drive robust strategic recommendations. Conceptual thinking skills must be complemented by a strong quantitative orientation
Execution: Manage and sequence delivery of business intent, build business requirements and execute against the location strategy. Oversee multiple projects and programs concurrently. Foster innovation, drive critical decisions, hold business partners accountable, and consistently deliver results
People leadership: May mentor, coach and develop 1-2 analysts with a goal of developing and retaining talent at Capital One
Partnership: Work closely with colleagues across Capital One to drive improvement in operating costs, deposit lift, and quality of customer experience. Build and leverage the capabilities of a high-performing team, as well as business partners across the enterprise
Competencies: Strong business judgment, leadership in ambiguous situations, and integrity. Impeccable written and oral communication credentials, coupled with strategic influencing skills and the ability to drive agreement through intellect, interpersonal and negotiation skills. Successful track record of thriving in a fast paced, entrepreneurial and dynamic environment. Previous consulting experience is a plus
Basic Qualifications:
At least 3 years of professional experience performing analysis
Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date: A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Business, Finance, Accounting, Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer engineering, Software engineering, Mechanical engineering, Information Systems or a related quantitative field)
A Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Business, Finance, Accounting, Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mechanical engineering, Information Systems or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration
Preferred Qualifications:
Master’s Degree in Business or quantitative field such as Finance, Economics, Physical Sciences, Math, Statistics, Engineering
5+ years of experience in analysis
2+ years of experience in financial services
1+ year of experience in consulting
2+ years of experience in people management

About Crowe Studio
Crowe Studio is a business unit dedicated to helping clients scale smarter, transform faster, and lead in a platform-driven economy. Built for speed and flexibility, Crowe Studio operates outside the constraints of traditional professional services delivery models, giving clients access to cross-disciplinary innovation, embedded AI capabilities, and global delivery resources—all in service of solving complex business challenges in faster, smarter ways.
Through Crowe Studio, the firm provides clients with an innovation partner focused on rapid execution, deep technology integration, and high-impact results. We’re building the next generation of business models for professional services, where human expertise and AI are embedded within clients’ operations to drive ongoing impact, not just deliver isolated projects.
As a member of Crowe Studio, you will help distinguish Crowe in the market and drive the firm’s technology and innovation strategy. The future is powered by AI—come build it with us.
About Forward Deployed Engineering
The Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) Practice drives AI transformation through embedded consulting and engineering, enabling clients to accelerate delivery, scale solutions, and capture value faster. Our approach helps companies prove AI in their own environments, delivering results in weeks, not months.
We embed our Forward Deployed Engineers side-by-side with client teams to spot opportunities, make AI concepts real, and deploy solutions rapidly. Unlike traditional consulting approaches that rely on documented requirements and lengthy development cycles, FDEs blend engineering, product thinking, workflow design, and business understanding to achieve shared, outcome-driven ownership until measurable results are achieved.
Our engagements range from 2-hour AI Immersion Labs that turn AI noise into real use cases, to multi-week Proof of Value Sprints that prototype and deploy game-changing AI solutions. We help companies de-risk AI adoption while demonstrating solid ROI.
About the Team
We invest in expertise . You’ll have the time, space, and support to go deep on client engagements and build lasting technical and strategic mastery. You’ll work with cross-functional teams and client teams as a trusted advisor and domain expert.
We believe in continuous growth . Our team is committed to professional development and knowledge-sharing.
We protect balance . Our distributed team culture is grounded in trust and flexibility. We offer unlimited PTO, a flexible remote work policy, and a supportive environment that prioritizes sustainable, long-term performance.
About the Role
As a Forward Deployed AI Architect (Manager), you will serve as a hands-on technical authority responsible for designing, developing, and delivering innovative, production-ready AI solutions for our clients. You will own solution architecture, technical feasibility, engineering quality, and production readiness while remaining actively involved in coding, prototyping, and complex technical problem-solving.
Working within Crowe Studio's Forward Deployed Engineering practice, you will collaborate directly with clients and cross-functional teams to translate complex business challenges into scalable, secure, and maintainable AI applications. Your work will span agentic AI systems, generative AI applications, enterprise integrations, cloud-native architectures, and production deployments.
This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who wants to expand their technical leadership and architectural influence without moving away from hands-on engineering. You will guide technical decisions, establish engineering standards, mentor engineers, and communicate architectural tradeoffs with confidence. You will also be empowered to challenge technical approaches that introduce unacceptable risk or will not meet production requirements.
What You’ll Do
Architect and develop end-to-end applied AI solutions, including generative AI applications, agentic systems, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and AI-enabled enterprise workflows.
Lead solution architecture for AI build and proof-of-concept engagements, ensuring solutions are technically feasible, scalable, secure, and aligned with client business objectives.
Remain hands-on across solution development, including application coding, data integration, prototyping, debugging, and technical implementation.
Design and implement cloud-native AI solutions using Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and relevant AI platforms and services.
Define architecture and integration patterns for large language models (LLMs), vector databases, APIs, microservices, enterprise data platforms, and client systems.
Take ownership of technical feasibility, solution design decisions, and build quality from initial discovery through production deployment.
Guide solutions through Architecture Review Board processes, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, responsible AI principles, and production readiness expectations.
Assess technical feasibility during client discovery sessions, solution scoping, and sales support discussions, clearly communicating technical tradeoffs, risks, and recommended approaches.
Establish engineering standards, reusable architectural patterns, technical documentation, and development best practices across client engagements.
Design solutions with appropriate evaluation frameworks, monitoring, observability, guardrails, and performance optimization to support reliable AI operations.
Collaborate with AI engineering, data engineering, MLOps, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, and security teams to deliver integrated enterprise solutions.
Evaluate technical tradeoffs among custom development, managed AI services, and low-code or automation platforms to select appropriate implementation strategies.
Identify and address technical risks, including performance, scalability, security, reliability, and cost considerations.
Mentor engineers through architecture reviews, code reviews, technical guidance, and hands-on problem-solving to strengthen engineering quality and team capabilities.
Evaluate emerging AI frameworks, cloud capabilities, and engineering tools to identify opportunities for innovation and continuous improvement.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field.
Minimum of 6 years of experience in production software engineering, cloud engineering, AI/ML engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Strong hands-on software engineering experience, including proficiency in modern programming languages, application development, and the design and deployment of production-grade solutions.
Demonstrated experience architecting cloud-native applications and distributed systems using Azure, AWS, or GCP, including APIs, microservices, enterprise integrations, and data workflows.
Working knowledge of generative AI and LLM application patterns, including prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search, and agentic workflows.
Ability to assess technical feasibility, evaluate architectural tradeoffs, and make sound engineering decisions considering scalability, security, performance, reliability, and cost.
Understanding of software and AI application lifecycle management, including testing, evaluation, production deployment, monitoring, and operational support.
Strong communication and client-facing skills, with demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions, explain complex architectural decisions, and mentor engineering teams.
Demonstrated ownership of technical delivery, engineering quality, and risk management in collaborative, fast-paced environments, with a commitment to remaining actively engaged in hands-on engineering.
Ability to travel up to 80%, depending on client and engagement requirements.

Experience developing and deploying production AI applications using LLMs or agent frameworks from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or similar providers, including tool orchestration and multi-step agentic workflows.
Experience designing evaluation frameworks for LLM and agentic systems, including quality, reliability, safety, performance, and responsible AI considerations.
Advanced cloud and AI infrastructure experience, including Kubernetes, Terraform, observability, and managed AI services such as Azure AI, Amazon SageMaker, or Google Vertex AI.
Experience architecting RAG solutions, integrating vector databases (such as Pinecone, Weaviate, or FAISS), and optimizing model inference or AI application performance.
Familiarity with AI-assisted development and low-code automation platforms, such as Microsoft Power Platform, Cursor, Replit, Retool, or n8n, along with experience supporting client discovery, technical scoping, or proof-of-value engagements.

DoorDash Parcel is building a new package delivery business on top of the largest local delivery network in the US, including millions of Dashers (our independent delivery partners), thousands of merchants, and DashMart (our own local fulfillment sites). We are a small, highly autonomous team that builds with AI by default and works directly with the leaders running the business.
About the Role
We’re hiring a Director of Network Strategy & Planning to own the design of the Parcel network: where packages enter, how they move and sort, how they reach the door, and the planning systems that decide all of it. Your decisions in the first 12 months will set the cost and service curve for Parcel for years, building on an existing local logistics network and what the team has built over the last 2-3 years.

Design short and long term topology plan for a network, and evaluate long term investments 3-5 years and solving near term P&L opportunities
Design the Parcel network end to end, including where packages enter, sort, and travel, and decide by city whether to build, lease, or partner. Design speed tenants, and customer facing experiences.
Set the delivery promise, cut-off times, and capacity plans for peak season and disruptions, and review plan versus actual results every week.
Turn package volume into delivery routes that are attractive to Dashers and profitable for DoorDash, and design pickup and long-distance trucking between sites with partner carriers.
Build the planning tools with Engineering and Data Science, prototyping simulation and optimization yourself with AI and Python before asking for headcount.
Be measured on speed, cost per package, network productivity, Dasher experience, and reliability, reviewed weekly as ranges rather than averages.
We’re excited about you because…
You have 12+ years of substantial experience leading strategy and operations in a complex, high-growth business, with a track record of building new offerings and scaling them into sustainable businesses.
You have deep experience designing or running parcel, last-mile, or logistics networks, including site design, package flow, and routing.
You have owned cost and service results for a network and make decisions based on data, including when the data disagrees with the plan.
You work well with Engineering, Data Science, and Operations to turn prototypes into products.

description:
About the Team
People Product builds the internal products the People team runs on across DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt, including the surfaces and automated workflows for every employee support experience. Our north star is to enable the People team to operate with best-in-class speed and efficiency, using emerging technology and a curious mindset to solve the problems that matter most to the people they support. Our team operates at two levels: we are experts in our specific People products, and we are the centralized People product team that defines the product standards, quality, and measures for all product managers across the People team.
About the Role
We're hiring a Staff Product Manager to own products for the People team's human resources (HR) partner products. These products support the specialized HR and HR-adjacent teams  (e.g., Employee Relations) whose expertise the broader People team relies on to support employees. You'll work closely with them to discover the pain points that keep them from their highest-value work, apply product judgment to define the problems and the solutions that augment or automate high-cost workflows, and set a clear vision for where human judgment remains essential. Success is measured in cost, quality, and time for these teams, with experience standards as the floor.
You will report into the Senior Manager, People Product on our People Product team in our Technology, Insights & Operations organization.
You're excited about this opportunity because you will…
Collaborate closely with Employee Relations specialists and People Business Partners in your first weeks, and come back with a clear diagnosis of the problems behind their requests.
Set the product vision and roadmap across the HR Partner team, and move People leaders at DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt from one-off requests to a shared plan they help set.
Build to learn with engineering and design: put prototypes in front of partners early, demo work in progress every two weeks, and make sure engineers hear problems from the customer first-hand.
Own the outcome of every bet, from the baseline and target before launch to the follow-up after it, and change course or stop when the measure says so.
Decide where AI and automation help and where a person must stay in the decision, especially on pay, discipline, leave, or employment status, working with Employment Legal, Privacy, and works councils across countries.
Bring strong product fundamentals and help scale them beyond your own space: contribute to the product standards, quality, and measures People Product sets for PMs across the People team, and share what works with other PM teams.
We're excited about you because…
You have 7+ years of product management experience, including end-to-end ownership of internal tools, HR technology, case management, support, or workflow automation products.
You understand how sensitive operational work gets done, such as employee relations, HR operations, legal or compliance work, investigations, or support casework, and not only how the systems are configured. You know where a decision about someone's job, pay, or leave has to stay with a person.
You turn requests into clearly defined problems before anything gets built, and you have measured your products' impact in cost, quality, or time against a baseline you set before launch.
You have set direction across senior partners outside product without formal authority, you work closely with engineering to scope down and ship in small increments, and you can explain a "not now" decision clearly.
You're excited about what AI and other emerging technology can do. You use it every day, including building your own agents that take on repeated work and draft first passes like PRDs, with you setting the standard and checking the output, and you stay focused on the solution that solves the problem, not the hype.

title: MRO Account Executive - Austin, TX
description:
About MISUMI Americas
MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.
Impact In This Role
The MRO Account Executive is responsible for identifying, developing, and expanding maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO) opportunities across targeted accounts, with a focus on industrial manufacturing and automation customers. This role drives growth of MISUMI Americas Factory Automation product offerings by building strong relationships with key stakeholders, understanding site-level maintenance needs, and delivering a high level of customer support. The manager partners closely with internal teams to develop account strategies, support demand forecasting, and help introduce new products, services, and solutions that improve uptime and standardize procurement for customers.
This role directly grows revenue and share of wallet within key manufacturing accounts, with a strong focus on working closely with the Spares team. The position partners with customer maintenance, engineering, and procurement teams to identify opportunities involving mechanical components and automation applications. An engineering background is a plus for building technical credibility, understanding customer requirements, diagnosing reliability and uptime challenges, and recommending the right MISUMI Americas solutions.
What You’ll Be Doing
Develop and maintain relationships with maintenance, operations, procurement, and engineering teams across assigned accounts
Identify and grow opportunities by understanding site-level maintenance needs, spend, and reliability challenges
Apply engineering and technical knowledge to evaluate customer applications, review component requirements and specifications, and recommend the right solutions
Promote MISUMI Americas Factory Automation solutions to improve uptime, reduce total cost, and increase overall share
Provide customer feedback to internal teams to support MRO product, service, and inventory program development
Create and deliver presentations, proposals, and account plans for customer stakeholders and internal leadership
Apply consultative selling strategies to expand MRO revenue
Support sales forecasting, pipeline management, and KPI tracking
Lead negotiations and manage implementation of programs and agreements
Collaborate cross-functionally to support account execution and ongoing customer needs
Support on-site account development and relationship building

1–3 years of experience in MRO, industrial sales, business development, or application engineering within a manufacturing or industrial environment
Technical aptitude to understand mechanical components, automation equipment, and engineering drawings or specifications, and to discuss them credibly with maintenance and engineering teams
Strong consultative selling and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify maintenance, reliability, and operational improvement opportunities
Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and relationship-management skills across maintenance, operations, procurement, and leadership teams
Results-driven mindset with demonstrated success growing accounts, expanding share of wallet, and developing long-term customer programs
Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to present value-based solutions and business cases
Proficiency with CRM systems and Microsoft Office tools, including Excel and PowerPoint
Self-motivated, accountable, and able to work independently while collaborating cross-functionally

Prior experience as an application, sales, maintenance/reliability, or manufacturing engineer

title: Security Engineer, Product Security
description:
About Flexport:
At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.
The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.
What You'll Do
Architecture & strategy
Define security architecture for Flexport's products and services , and set the patterns and reference implementations that make secure-by-default the path of least resistance.
Lead security engineering reviews for the highest-risk product features , and set the bar for what "good" looks like in reviews you don't personally run.
Build and scale the security champions program and product security training that extend your judgment into teams where you can't be in every review.
Design-time & review
Lead domain-specific threat modeling and attack surface analysis across Flexport's product surface, not just individual features.
Partner with engineering leadership to resolve the design tradeoffs that a senior engineer would escalate.
Vulnerability management
Set the bar for how the team triages, reproduces, and prioritizes bug bounty submissions and internal security reports, and step in on the hardest or highest-severity cases.
Drive remediation of systemic classes of vulnerability , not just individual findings.
Developer enablement & leadership
Own the security services and tooling consumed by product teams across our global infrastructure.
Mentor other engineers on the team, and act as the authoritative technical voice on product security across engineering leadership.
You Should Have
Typically 2–5 years of experience in product/application security or software development with a security focus — we care more about what you've built than the exact number. If you meet most of this, apply; we'd rather see your work than filter you out on a résumé line.
Strong grasp of web application security principles and common attack vectors (e.g., OWASP Top 10)
Proficiency with application testing tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, or browser developer tools
Working knowledge of at least one modern programming language (e.g., Ruby, Java/Kotlin, TypeScript/JavaScript, Python) and at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure)
Comfortable with security on-call rotation and picking up work across security disciplines when needed
Nice to Have
Hands-on experience with bug bounty platforms
Hands-on experience with SAST tools (Cycode, Semgrep, Snyk, or similar)
Experience with cloud infrastructure security and container technologies
Participation in CTF events or open-source security projects
Familiarity with threat modeling frameworks and secure SDLC best practices
Interest in contributing to internal developer security training programs
How We Work
We're in the San Francisco office regularly to whiteboard and ship together
We stay closely aligned with teammates on other continents via Slack, video, and async docs
We have the latest hardware and software, including frontier AI models on day one
We're agile, but not dogmatic — the team decides how it works best
Why This Role Is Special

Experience performing IEC 60974-1 type and routine testing for welding equipment.

As a Principal Electrical Engineer, you will set technical direction and strategy for the innovative surgical energy equipment and accessories portfolio for Intuitive’s da Vinci Surgical System, shaping architecture and technology roadmaps across multiple products and programs. You’ll thrive in a dynamic, high-energy environment, making sound decisions with incomplete information—typical of cutting-edge product development. The ideal candidate has deep technical expertise, a track record of successful medical product development across multiple product generations, and a collaborative, mentorship-driven approach that elevates engineering capability across the organization.
Essential Job Duties
·       Technical Ownership:
Collaborate with Marketing, Software, and Clinical Engineering to define and refine product requirements across multiple programs within the Advanced Energy portfolio.
·       Technical Strategy & Roadmap:
Define the multi-year technology and architecture roadmap for energy-based surgical platforms, setting technical direction that spans multiple products and programs.
·       System Integration:
Identify and implement methods to satisfy product specs, ensuring seamless integration into effective system designs.
·       Development & Testing:
Develop, validate, and document hardware solutions that meet clinical and environmental requirements.
·       Problem Solving:
Provide technical expertise to resolve complex design, manufacturing, or field challenges.
·       Prototyping:
Guide prototyping and feasibility studies for future product concepts, directing engineers through build, test, and down-select decisions.
·       Stakeholder Support:
Offer expert guidance on energy-based surgical products to internal company stakeholders, including senior leadership and executive technical reviews.
·       Organizational Influence:
Represent Advanced Energy engineering in cross-divisional and executive-level technical reviews; influence platform, architecture, and make/buy decisions at a business-unit level.
·       Quality & Regulatory:
Define risk management strategy and process (DFMEA, hazard analysis, risk/benefit assessment per ISO 14971) and design verification/validation planning to ensure compliance with IEC 60601 series standards, and applicable FDA/international regulatory requirements. Author or review technical documentation supporting regulatory submissions (e.g., 510(k), CE/MDR technical files).
·       Clinical Collaboration & Validation:
Partner with Clinical Engineering, surgeons, and human factors teams to validate device performance against real-world surgical use cases, including support for cadaver labs, animal studies, or clinical evaluations as needed.
·       Risk Management Leadership:
Drive cross-functional risk analysis activities throughout the product lifecycle, identifying and mitigating electrical, mechanical, and use-related hazards for patient and user safety across the product portfolio.
·       Mentorship & Technical Leadership:
Formally mentor Staff and Senior engineers, lead cross-team design reviews, and drive technical communities of practice to raise engineering capability across the organization.

Proficient in mixed signal design, embedded system design, and patient-isolated PCBA design.
Skilled in component selection, lifecycle management, and design for reliability/manufacturability.
Experienced in PCB fabrication, assembly, and testing.
Hardware development in fast-paced, high-impact environments.
Knowledgeable in all product development phases: design, implementation, debugging, verification, validation, and manufacturing transfer.
Team player with hands-on engineering experience.
Demonstrated application of medical electrical equipment standards (e.g., IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2 EMC, IEC 60601-2-2 for HF surgical equipment) in product design and verification.
Strong communicator, able to influence and collaborate across teams and levels.
Willingness to travel (~5-10%).
Growth mindset; eager to learn and solve tough technical challenges.
Passion for creating robust, reliable products.
Hands-on experience with electrical safety design and testing for patient-connected circuitry.
Direct experience with medical device design controls, including risk/hazard analysis, design verification and validation (V&V) planning and execution.
Demonstrated technical leadership across multiple technical domains or product platforms, with the ability to influence architecture and strategy decisions org-wide without formal authority.
Track record of successfully developing and launching multiple products or product generations through the full product development lifecycle.
